cc:Work.dc:description:
Regular polygon boxes that form a star when closed
![Open box](static/samples/RegularStarBox-2.jpg)
Created with Boxes.py (https://boxes.hackerspace-bamberg.de/) Command line: boxes RegularStarBox --n 3 --radius 80 --h 50 --reference 0 --labels 0 Command line short: boxes RegularStarBox --n --radius --h --reference --labels
